newsitem.title: FRANCE: French capital markets closing report.
newsitem.headline: French capital markets closing report.

text.p: The March bond future finished above a resistance level at 128.94, but in subdued volume which left the market doubtful whether the gain was significant.
"There's nothing happening," said one trader. "The market has a good trend but the break above (128.)94 is not really significant in such an illiquid market."

The French government is expected to decide on December 3 on two replacements for the Bank of France's monetary policy council, whose mandates expires in early January. The council met today and gave an opinion on the six candidates proposed for the posts, council member Paul Marchelli told Reuters.
